name: Jagged Knife Shadow
description: A nimble scoundrel bearing a wicked knife and utilizing shadow magic to isolate targets.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: When the Shadow succeeds on a standard attack that has advantage, they deal 1d6+6 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

abilities.name: Cloaked
abilities.description: Become Hidden until after the Shadow’s next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.
